payout_quote: Open a new 360 Checking account with promo code CHECKING250 and receive at least 2 qualifying direct deposits of $500 or more each within 75 days of account opening; the $250 bonus is deposited into the new account after you complete these steps.
timing: Deposited into the new account after you complete all requirements (no fixed day count stated officially).
steps: Go to https://www.capitalone.com/bank/checking250/ and open a new 360 Checking account using promo code CHECKING250.
Within 75 days of opening, receive at least 2 qualifying direct deposits of $500 or more each.
Keep the account open and in good standing; the $250 bonus is deposited after you complete the steps.
Re-confirm the offer is still live before opening — Capital One can end or change it at any time (no fixed end date).
catches: Requires promo code CHECKING250 at account opening — opening without the code gets $0.
At least 2 qualifying direct deposits, each $500 or more, within 75 days of account opening.
Ineligible if you have or had a 360 Checking, Simply Checking, or Total Control Checking account (primary or secondary) on/after Jan 1, 2024.
Account must be open and in good standing when the bonus is deposited; one promo code per account; cannot combine with other 360 Checking opening offers.
No fixed end date — limited-time offer that Capital One can end or change at its discretion; re-confirm before acting.
360 Checking has no monthly fees or minimums; variants exist ($400 flash code FLASH400, $250 STUDENT250/DEBIT250) — this route covers the standing CHECKING250 offer.
biggest_catch: You need two direct deposits of $500+ each within 75 days, and anyone who has held a Capital One 360/Simply/Total Control Checking account since January 1, 2024 is ineligible.
eligibility: New 360 Checking customers 18+; not a current/former Capital One checking holder since 1/1/2024.
